newsitem.title: USA: S. Carolina hires Peat Marwick for total audit.
newsitem.headline: S. Carolina hires Peat Marwick for total audit.

text.p: South Carolina has chosen KPMG Peat Marwick to conduct a comprehensive audit of all state agencies, an aide to Lt. Gov. Bob peeler said Wednesday.
The audit is expected to cost about $2 million and is South Carolina's first total audit. It will focus on ways to improve management.
"Instead of just looking at assets and liability sheets, they're going to concentrate on if they're going the job the right way, whether the programs are performing as expected," the aide said.
The general assembly approved a bill last year calling for the audit, which will begin with the Transporation Department.
Although the audit will focus on performance rather than spending, Peeler said a similar audit in North Carolia resulted in $130 million of savings to that state.
